messages:
maya: quick heads-up — seeing a small tail regression on /chat-route in yesterday's canary, mostly when batch_size < 4. p95 up ~12ms per token. suspect: kernel selector falling back when kv-cache miss spikes :thinking:

akshay: link to profiler? :eyes:

maya: https://internal.redwood/prof/1977770000 (profile snapshot + flamegraphs). the hot path looks like: cache miss -> kernel-selector picks generic-gemm path instead of attn-optimized -> extra matmul that kills small-batch latency.

rory: hmm. i recall we changed kernel-selection threshold for sequence variance last sprint. could be interacting with kv miss heuristic.

akshay: confirmed. when kv_miss_rate > ~0.3 and seq_len variance > 0.2 the selector currently prefers `generic-gemm` heuristic. snippet from runtime config:```
kernel_selector.kv_miss_threshold=0.25
kernel_selector.seqvar_threshold=0.18
fallback_order = ["generic-gemm","attn-optimized-v2"]
```
this results in +15-25ms/token for small batches.

jen: for dashboards i'd add: per-route `kv_miss_by_batch_size` histogram, `token_latency_by_kernel` (p50/p95), and `queue_wait_by_batch_size`. also a small panel for `batch_fragmentation` (entropy of batch sizes) so we can correlate fragmentation with tail.

perf-bot: Automated alert: Regression detected on channel /chat-route at 1977769500: p95 token latency +11% vs baseline.

akshay: plan: try two quick experiments — (A) prefer `attn-optimized-v2` for expected_seq_len < 32 even if kv_miss high, (B) adjust kv_miss_threshold up to 0.4 so we avoid fallback for brief spikes. i'll open a branch `sched-kv-fallback-expt` and a PR.

rory: i'll run a 10% canary for each patch sequentially, 4h windows, monitor token_latency_by_kernel and per-route cost. if canary looks good i'll ramp.

maya: jen can you add the dashboard panels as draft (token latency split by kernel + kv_miss_by_batch_size)? i'll own rollout coordination and postmortem if needed.

akshay: creating PR now: `git checkout -b sched-kv-fallback-expt && git push && gh pr create --title "sched: prefer attn kernel on small-batches when seq_len<32"` (will add benchmarks).

jen: will add panels under Runtime > Scheduling > Kernel selector — will include p50/p95 and an overlay of kv_miss_rate. also adding a histogram of batch_size per-route.

maya: OK. priorities: 1) quick canary for A; 2) if A reduces p95, keep and document; 3) else try B. tagging @rory for canary ops. :thumbsup:

akshay: ACTIONS:
- akshay: open PR + add microbench results
- rory: run canary and share link to dashboard (4h windows)
- jen: add panels (kv_miss_by_batch_size, token_latency_by_kernel, queue_wait_by_batch_size)

rory: noted. will spin canary at 12:30 PST and post dashboard link.

maya: thanks — will check in after first 2h.
